evidence.text: Memory evaluation benchmarks are beginning to be created to measure this application of a memory system. They test things like the ability to share conversational knowledge and governance around sharing facts, but do so separately. We have not found a benchmark that provides a complete evaluation of governed organisational memory: how practices, requirements and work products are established, scoped, revised and applied across a company.

We adopt a graded approach to evaluation. Rather than one verdict per scenario, we break each expected effect of memory into a separate checkable property of the output. If an earlier review established that an opportunity qualifies only with confirmed budget, an identified decision-maker, and a timeline inside six months, then a later account review missing the budget can be judged on three counts independently.
